newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines to make statement on Korean defector.
newsitem.headline: Philippines to make statement on Korean defector.

text.p: The Philippine foreign ministry will make a statement on Tuesday afternoon after being swamped with queries on whether North Korean defector Hwang Jang-yop is coming to the country, an official told Reuters.
Foreign underscretary Rodolfo Severino will make a statement between 3.00 and 4.00 p.m. (0700 and 0800 GMT), spokesman Ambassador Oscar Valenzuela said.
Speculation that Hwang was coming to the Philippines on his way to South Korea has intensified after foreign secretary Domingo Siazon said last week Manila was prepared to take him in transit.
"This is a top security matter. From that alone, you can just imagine that only one or two people will know and perhaps not even all the details," Valenzuela told Reuters by phone.
"Definitely, I don't know anything," he said, adding the reason the Foreign Office would make the statement was "there have been many queries and we have to say something".
On Tuesday a China Southern Airlines flight left the southeastern Chinese city of Xiamen for Manila, officials said, but they would not confirm if Hwang was on board.
